atomMapping: C1-C4 butadiene, C5-C6 ethylene, H7-H16; neutral singlet C6H10, 46 electrons

coordinateConvention.metric: Sum of sqrt(sum_i mass_i * |delta Cartesian r_i|^2) over accepted points. Discrete chord length, not exact analytic arc length. No step interpolation. Fixed r1 atom mapping; native laboratory coordinates with no independent per-point rotation.

endpointMinimumVerification: Separate endpoint optimization/Hessian/stability required; convergence alone is insufficient.
